help_center.title: Help Center
help_center.faq1_q: How do I book a service?
help_center.faq1_a: Simply choose a category from the home screen, select the service you need, choose a date and time slot, and confirm your booking. You'll receive a notification once it's confirmed!
help_center.faq2_a: Yes, you can cancel your booking up to 2 hours before the scheduled time. Go to 'My Bookings', select the booking, and tap 'Cancel'.
help_center.faq3_q: How do I pay for the service?
help_center.faq3_a: Currently, we support Cash on Delivery. We are working on adding online payment options via UPI, Credit/Debit cards, and Wallets very soon!
help_center.faq4_q: What if I'm not satisfied with the service?
help_center.faq4_a: Your satisfaction is our priority. If you're unhappy with the service, please contact our support team within 24 hours, and we'll resolve it for you.
help_center.faq5_q: Is there a warranty on the work?
help_center.faq5_a: Most services come with a 7-day service warranty. Please check the service details page for specific warranty information.
help_center.still_need_help_desc: Send us an email and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
